# SI000 — suppression-or-parse-error

Suppressions need a reason and sources must parse.

## Why

An unexplained suppression bypasses a safety rule. A parse error means no rule can run at all.

## Bad

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI023
```

## Good

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI023 -- allowlisted archive URL
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI000 -- reason
```
